blocking_preconditions.action: Accept, reject, or otherwise dispose of the unresolved public-artifact-generation, baseline-definition, and inherited separate-provider questions through an ADR-018/v4 clarification. This proposal does not define their evaluation criteria or values.
blocking_preconditions.evidence: Accepted decision reference that identifies the successor-contract scope or an explicit continued block.

blocking_preconditions.action: Externally appoint and attest the evaluator, reviewer, registry custodian, key custodian, audit owner, release authority, and recognition authority, including identity, organization, reporting line, qualifications, mandate, conflict disclosure, validity, and handoff/deputy process.
blocking_preconditions.evidence: External appointment and organizational-separation attestations; no repository identity, subagent, branch, worktree, or process label qualifies.

blocking_preconditions.action: Prepare, recompute, and accept a clean committed public-only v4 candidate-freeze receipt with every required canonical digest before any hidden attachment.
blocking_preconditions.evidence: Reviewer recomputation record for the complete freeze receipt and public-only bundle.

v4_custody_reconciliation_proposal.current_v4_model: hidden_dataset_provider is a logical custody duty performed by independent_evaluator_only.
v4_custody_reconciliation_proposal.legacy_surface_treatment: Inherited separate-provider/provider_id organization, attestation, registry, and handoff surfaces are a proposed replacement only; they are not admissible for EVAL-01 v4 until an accepted ADR-018/v4 clarification changes the binding.

inherited_separate_provider_surface_inve.observed_surface: independent_provider_only seed visibility, provider_id, and separate provider commitment
separate artifact provider and evaluator operating procedure
separate provider identity and evaluator/provider/implementation organization validation
test fixture and assertion for separate provider and evaluator organizations

ordered_external_workflow.action: Resolve OP-B1 through an accepted architecture clarification or record a rejected disposition.
ordered_external_workflow.admission_rule: No subsequent workflow step is admissible while OP-B1 is unresolved.
ordered_external_workflow.output: Accepted decision reference or explicit continued block.

ordered_external_workflow.action: Resolve OP-B2 and approve external organizational separation and admissibility governance.
ordered_external_workflow.admission_rule: The implementation owner cannot self-attest or control acceptance of any required separation, custody, registry, or key record.
ordered_external_workflow.output: Externally attested appointments and separation evidence.

ordered_external_workflow.action: Accept the frozen v4 specification and protocol digest, role attestations, reviewer-controlled registry, trusted Ed25519 public-key entries, validity intervals, and revocation process.
ordered_external_workflow.admission_rule: Unknown, expired, revoked, self-supplied, mismatched, or unverifiable registry or key evidence is rejected.
ordered_external_workflow.output: Accepted external registry references without private keys or hidden material.

ordered_external_workflow.action: Submit and independently recompute the clean, committed, public-only v4 candidate, complete freeze receipt, manifests, and canonical digest bindings.
ordered_external_workflow.admission_rule: Any post-freeze source, dependency, model, parameter, protocol, threshold, generator, or candidate change invalidates the receipt.
ordered_external_workflow.output: Reviewer acceptance or rejection of the freeze receipt.

ordered_external_workflow.action: As the sole v4 hidden-material custodian and logical hidden_dataset_provider duty holder, create the sealed artifact outside the repository and record its pre-run commitment.
ordered_external_workflow.admission_rule: Seed, examples, labels, latent variables, private implementation details, and per-sequence correctness never enter the implementation trust domain.
ordered_external_workflow.output: Non-disclosing commitment reference and sole-custody attestation for reviewer completeness review.

ordered_external_workflow.action: Execute the accepted frozen candidate and evaluator-owned baselines and ablations in fresh, read-only, network-disabled, bounded, effect-free processes.
ordered_external_workflow.admission_rule: Every completed, failed, aborted, crashed, duplicate, and missing-output attempt is finalised in the append-only ledger; no silent retry or replacement is permitted.
ordered_external_workflow.output: Complete external attempt-ledger commitment and aggregate results only.

ordered_external_workflow.action: Release permitted aggregate evidence in canonical JSON with SHA-256 bindings and a detached Ed25519 signature from a trusted non-revoked key.
ordered_external_workflow.admission_rule: Private keys, signing tokens, raw hidden material, and raw per-sequence outcomes are excluded.
ordered_external_workflow.output: Aggregate signed evidence package and key-status reference.

ordered_external_workflow.action: Verify registry and attestation freshness, signature and key status, receipt bindings, ledger completeness, contamination, hard failures, resource results, and claim boundary.
ordered_external_workflow.admission_rule: Any unknown, missing, stale, contradictory, contaminated, unsigned, revoked, or incomplete evidence is inadmissible.
ordered_external_workflow.output: External admissibility recommendation; no gate result.

ordered_external_workflow.action: Assess admissible evidence only under the accepted evaluation-gate process.
ordered_external_workflow.admission_rule: Preparation, signature, aggregate score, or admissibility recommendation never automatically passes G0, G1, a stage exit, release, recognition, runtime activation, or NB-2 activation.
ordered_external_workflow.output: Separate gate-review disposition or continued block.

repository_follow_up_tests: Reject use of inherited separate-provider execution surfaces as EVAL-01 v4 evidence before an accepted clarification.
Require the proposed v4 successor to bind hidden_custody_duty.custodian_evaluator_id to evaluator.evaluator_id and prohibit an independent provider identity or organization.
Preserve rejection of unknown, revoked, expired, mismatched, self-signed, incomplete, repeated, post-freeze, leaked, contaminated, or non-append-only evidence.
Preserve aggregate-only output, no hidden-material repository state, no gate/release/recognition claim, and no NB-2 activation.
